name: com.gameframex.unity.tuyoogame.yooasset.wechat
description:
GameFrameX YooAsset WeChat — WeChat mini-game FileSystem adapter for Unity WebGL, integrating the WeChat mini-game SDK AssetBundle download and cache flow into YooAsset. Provides a dedicated IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider and IFileSystem implementation that hooks into YooAsset's standard initialization, covering package version requests, manifest loading, asset bundle download and loading, and pluggable remote and decryption service pipelines. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX YooAsset WeChat — 微信小游戏 FileSystem 适配功能包。提供专属 IWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider 与 IFileSystem 实现，将微信小游戏 SDK 的 AssetBundle 下载与缓存流程接入 YooAsset 标准初始化链路，覆盖包版本请求、清单加载、资源包下载与加载，以及可插拔的远程服务与解密管线。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
